text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Sakura 
Bakushin O, we were talking about her 
classmate.

She was leaving the school. She had said 
that she "wanted to give it her all in her 
last race."――
choice_data_list:
That girl's last race, it's tomorrow, 
isn't it.

That girl's last race, it's tomorrow, 
isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've done all I can, and I'm 
absolutely for-certain she'll win first 
place!!

On the day of the race, Sakura Bakushin 
O's entire class showed up to watch the 
mock race.
choice_data_list: It's finally time for the match.
It's finally time for the match.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!! You have the capabilities to 
do the best Bakushin there ever was!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Bakushinbakushin, right!

As the race began, Sakura Bakushin O and 
the others cheered loudly for their 
classmate.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Nice going, good, good! It's coming―!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's it right there, that's it!! Let's 
show everyone the fruits of our labor!!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
(Baku-chan, everyone… Truly, thank you all 
so much.)

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: (Go on and watch me, this is my――)

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: The best I can do, Bakushin…!!!!!

Before long, the race was over, and the 
results for her classmate are――

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Fifth place, you got fifth place! You're 
in the top five!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Haha, she's waving! She looks so happy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Uuuuugh…!

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I'm gonna go talk to her alone for 
a minute.

Sorry, I'm gonna go talk to her alone for 
a minute.

text_block_list.text:
I pulled Sakura Bakushin O's hand, who was 
shocked by the results, and moved to a 
place where we could talk comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uuug… This is all my lack of ability!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the class president, I said I'd help! 
And yet, I couldn't get her to win first 
place…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's her last race, and I…!!
choice_data_list: But she looked so happy.
But she looked so happy.
Pull yourself together, class president!
Pull yourself together, class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's her last race, and I…!!
choice_data_list: But she looked so happy.
But she looked so happy.
Pull yourself together, class president!
Pull yourself together, class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Th, that's… I can't deny that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When she was running, and when she reached 
the goal, she looked so happy and 
cheerful.
choice_data_list:
Because it was a result she could be proud 
of.

Because it was a result she could be proud 
of.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Yes. I was the only one who was obsessed 
with first place.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu, what a pathetic class president, 
misreading the wishes of her classmates.
choice_data_list: Do you know what you need to do now?
Do you know what you need to do now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I must congratulate her! I should be the 
one to take the initiative――

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There she is, there she is, 
Baku-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're…!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: I just got the best ranking ever!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Baku-chan and everyone… It was 
the best race ever!!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ba, Baku-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A hug, to celebrate how bravely you 
fought!! It was… the best Bakushin ever!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ….Yeah……Yeah!!

Sakura Bakushin O and her classmates shed 
tears of joy and hugged each other for a 
long while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y, yessir!?
choice_data_list: Remind yourself what she wanted.
Remind yourself what she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, ah… She said she wanted to finish 
her last race with a satisfying run.
choice_data_list: So, did she not do that today?
So, did she not do that today?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
By no means!! I deny it in the name of the 
class president!!
choice_data_list:
Then, it shouldn't matter if you're in 
first or not.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…That's right. I must congratulate her on 
her results!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating, but… it's rude to her to 
be frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to her! And then, 
compliment her to the fullest――

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There she is, there she is, 
Baku-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're…!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: I just got the best ranking ever!

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Baku-chan and everyone… It was 
the best race ever!!

text_block_list.text: Ba, Baku-chan!?

text_block_list.text:
A hug, to celebrate how bravely you 
fought!! It was… the best Bakushin ever!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ….Yeah……Yeah!!

Sakura Bakushin O and her classmates shed 
tears of joy and hugged each other for a 
long while.
